selection_evidence.mechanism: Product owner selections in this implementation conversation

handover: Source owner proposes after password plus recent MFA; active same-office colleague accepts after password plus recent MFA. Promote recipient before demoting source; revoke both session revisions.
last_owner: Retain at least one active owner with an active user in every already-owned active office. No inferred owner for legacy ownerless offices.
invitation: Recipient email and office bound, 24-hour single-use token. Recipient acceptance creates an inactive accountant profile; explicit owner approval activates it.
reactivation: Explicit owner action, always accountant role; global user deactivation and pending invitation approval cannot be bypassed.
unimplemented_capabilities: Denied by default; future delegated adapters must recheck named capability and office at execution.
implementation_defaults_not_separate_pol: 30 management requests per actor per 15 minutes
approval_scope: Current staff, office, client and legacy finance operations plus mutual ownership handover; later reversal/export/connection/job scope needs its own reviewed capabilities.
